 At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.
 All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .
 AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.
 About the Role 
 Gusto is looking for a seasoned performance marketer to own execution across paid social and emerging acquisition channels, testing new platforms, formats, and tactics to find what works before scaling. This is a high-visibility role at the intersection of performance marketing, channel experimentation, and AI-powered workflow design. You will own execution and day-to-day strategy for paid social and new channel tests, working within Gusto's demand generation framework, with clear accountability to pipeline and revenue targets.
 About the Team 
 As a member of Gusto's Demand Generation team, you will be embedded specifically within Paid Acquisition, a focused group responsible for driving awareness and pipeline through paid media. This team operates with high autonomy, a bias for experimentation, and a culture of cross-functional partnership. We hold ourselves to a high standard, move fast, and genuinely believe that being AI-native is part of what it means to do this job well today.
 Here's what you'll do day-to-day: 
 Own paid social strategy and execution across Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit, Quora, and TikTok, driving full-funnel campaigns from brand awareness through retargeting and conversion, with accountability to pipeline and revenue targets.
 Manage significant, multi-million dollar budgets with rigor, including campaign pacing, forecasting, budget-vs-actuals analysis, and making the case for paid social investment in imperfect attribution environments.
 Apply and help refine Gusto's paid acquisition measurement framework, including attribution philosophy and budget allocation principles, in partnership with the broader marketing team. Collaborate with Engineering to launch new pixels and tracking, troubleshoot platform-side issues, and QA implementations, keeping measurement reliable as tracking needs evolve.
 Lead creative strategy and testing at scale: briefing creative studios and agencies, structuring meaningful experiments, interpreting complex data sets to drive actionable insights, and building a clear learning roadmap. Align with the Brand and Influencer team to run the organic-to-paid feedback loop: turning proven organic and influencer content into paid scale, and feeding results back to sharpen what earns that investment next.
 Use AI tools as a consistent, habitual part of your workflow: generating campaign briefs, developing copy variants, accelerating audience research, and building reusable systems that raise the bar for the whole team. Serve as the team's go-to expert on paid social and AI-powered marketing workflows, documenting playbooks and best practices for the paid acquisition team.
 Identify, test, and validate new digital media channels and formats beyond core paid social (such as Google Demand Generation campaigns and ChatGPT ads), running structured pilots, defining success criteria upfront, and making the call on scale vs. kill within existing budget guardrails.
 Partner cross-functionally with Integrated Marketing, Product Marketing, Sales, Communications, and Web to align paid social with integrated campaigns and earned media moments, and bring performance data back upstream to influence creative production and asset strategy. Partner with Web Marketing to align on landing page strategy, message match, and post-click conversion, because paid social performance doesn't end at the click.
 Here's what we're looking for:

 Job Description 
 Responsabilités principales
 1. Contrat et réclamations
 Maîtriser les dispositions contractuelles (périmètre, exclusions, avenants) et assurer la gestion de la portion chantier du contrat client.
 Identifier les écarts contractuels et préparer les réclamations client en collaboration avec le Directeur de Projet et le Contract Manager.
 Garantir la rigueur de la collecte des preuves et de l'imputation des coûts (WBS approprié, heures correctement imputées).

 Mettre à jour les outils budgétaires, évaluer les risques financiers et aligner les prévisions avec le Directeur de Projet.

 Assurer le lancement des demandes d'achat sur la base des besoins communiqués par le TFA ou le Site Manager.

 Veiller à l'alignement des engagements des sous-traitants avec les priorités SQDC de GEV, notamment les exigences EHS intégrées aux SoW.

 Consolider le budget de mobilisation.

 Définir la stratégie d'outillage (achat ou location).

 Suivre les indicateurs de sécurité, qualité, livraison et coûts.
 Examiner chaque semaine l'avancement des non-conformités (NC) et veiller au traitement des points critiques.
 Assurer le suivi des délais et du budget des livrables Méthodes, sans intervenir dans leur contenu technique.
 Coordonner les activités du chantier avec les équipes Engineering et Supply Chain.
 Effectuer des visites régulières sur les chantiers.
 6. Mise en service
 Présenter à l'équipe de mise en service le périmètre des travaux et les exigences associées.
 Coordonner la planification de la mise en service, le suivi budgétaire et la préparation des documents requis.
 7. EHS qualité
 Veiller à ce que l'environnement, l'hygiène et la sécurité (EHS) demeurent une priorité sur le chantier, sous la responsabilité opérationnelle du Site Manager.
 S'assurer que les obligations EHS sont intégrées aux contrats de sous-traitance et vérifier régulièrement l'application des normes et des pratiques de sécurité.
 8. Gouvernance et amélioration continue
 Soutenir le Directeur de Projet dans la gestion des enjeux, des risques et des escalades.
 Maintenir à jour la matrice de communication (GEV, client et équipes internes) ainsi que l'organigramme C&C.
 Animer les retours d'expérience (Lessons Learned) après chaque phase majeure : démontage, montage et mise en service.
 Préparer et coordonner la démobilisation du chantier en fin de projet.
 Droits de décision
 Le/la PMCC est responsable du budget, de l'imputation des coûts, des écarts contractuels et des réclamations. Il/elle détient l'autorité sur le lancement et la validation des achats, la gestion des contrats de sous-traitance ainsi que la conduite des Gate Reviews et des Lessons Learned. Il/elle dispose également d'un droit de veto sur les décisions ayant un impact sur le chantier.

 Requis
 Minimum de 5 ans d'expérience (3 ans pour un profil exceptionnel) en gestion de projets de construction ou dans un rôle PMCC équivalent impliquant le contrôle des coûts et la gestion contractuelle sur des sites industriels ou énergétiques.
 Solide expérience en gestion budgétaire, prévisions financières, réclamations, avenants contractuels et gestion des sous-traitants (RFQ, SoW, facturation).
 Forte culture EHS et sens aigu de la qualité.
 Diplôme en ingénierie ou expérience terrain équivalente.
 Excellente maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.
 Leadership, rigueur et capacité à prendre des décisions, à dire « non » et à influencer sans autorité technique directe.
 Poste basé à Brossard, avec disponibilité pour des déplacements réguliers sur les chantiers au Québec et ailleurs au Canada.
 Atouts importants
 Solide expérience dans le secteur hydroélectrique (turbines, alternateurs, équipements auxiliaires mécaniques et électriques).

 Support the Project Director in managing issues, risks, and escalations.

The role requires a strong technical understanding of how Treasury identifies, measures, monitors, and governs balance sheet risk, including key IRR and ALM concepts such as Net Interest Income (NII), Economic Value of Equity (EVE), balance sheet behavioral assumptions, deposit modeling, stress scenarios, hedging strategies, and management reporting.
 The successful candidate will support annual audit planning, risk assessments, audit scoping, audit execution, issue development, and regulatory engagement activities across Global Treasury.  Why this role is important to us 
 The audit team plays an important role in the overall success of the organization.  Serve as a Treasury subject matter leader within Corporate Audit, providing technical challenge and guidance on Interest Rate Risk, Asset Liability Management, and funding-related audits.

 Strong understanding of Interest Rate Risk and Asset Liability Management frameworks, including IRRBB governance, behavioral assumptions, deposit modeling, NII/EVE sensitivity analysis, stress testing, hedging strategies, model usage, and management reporting.

 Better Everyday : review every brand moment against its goal, and make the next one bigger, cheaper or better.

The Company 
 Versaterm is a PE-backed, high-growth SaaS company building a fully integrated platform across the entire public safety ecosystem — dispatch, law enforcement, forensics, courts, and beyond . We've grown through strategic acquisitions and deep product investment. What connects all of it is a single purpose: give public safety agencies the tools and insights to make better decisions in high-stakes moments. 
 When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades. 
 AI is central to where we're going. Not as a feature but as core infrastructure. We're embedding intelligence directly into the workflows our customers rely on every day, and we're doing it alongside them. Our customers tell us what the mission demands. We build what answers it. 
 This work attracts a specific kind of person — someone who wants to be pushed by great people, build things that outlast a sprint cycle, and go home knowing the work connected back to something real. 
 The Role 
 The vCAD Administrator is Versaterm's dedicated, embedded resource for the New Brunswick provincial customer (NB911) and its Regional Partner Agencies (RPAs), beginning with the Saint John Police and Fire PSAP and Codiac Fire PSAP. You will be the primary person supporting and maintaining the unified computer aided dispatch (CAD) and mobile data (MDT) systems, including the CAD/Mobile geo file and map displays.
 This role begins during implementation, at Workshop #1 for Saint John, and continues through go-live and ongoing operations. You will become the resident expert on how each agency's CAD is configured, and the trusted link between dispatch operations, provincial GIS authorities, and Versaterm's product and support teams.
 What You Do 
 System Configuration and Maintenance 
 Help the Customer and RPAs define, build, and maintain static configuration tables (unit IDs, unit types, status codes), incident types, and command line configuration.
 Build and maintain police and fire response areas, including fire box alarms/run cards, fire unit recommendation orders, and police districts and beats.
 Configure application business logic rules based on Customer and RPA needs, and document New Brunswick-specific configuration settings.
 Manage user profiles, permissions, and security for RPA personnel.
 Replicate configuration data between production, test, and training environments.
 Support interface configuration, documentation, and ongoing maintenance in coordination with Versaterm, the Customer, and RPAs.
 Requirements, Testing and Change Management 
 Translate end-user requirements into technical requirements.
 Guide and support the Customer and RPAs through functional and system acceptance testing.
 Evaluate system modification requests, consult on process changes and application options, and carry user-generated recommendations to Versaterm product teams.
 Coordinate application updates, enhancements, patches, and hotfixes across CAD workstations and MDTs, including promotion from test to production.
 Participate in the organizational change management workstream as requested.
 GIS and Mapping 
 Establish a regular cadence of GIS and mapping updates with the Customer and RPAs.
 Load and test provincial GIS updates in CAD and MDT, including street centerlines, address points, response areas, information layers, common places, building pre-plans, and aerial photography.
 Manage GIS data import and maintenance within CAD, troubleshoot mapping issues, and resolve data issues with provincial GIS authorities.
 Serve as subject matter expert on CAD and MDT street and map displays, and maintain documentation of New Brunswick GIS updates.
 Support, Troubleshooting and Training 
 Provide end-user application assistance and guidance on desktop and device application installs and updates.
 Work with Customer and RPA technical SMEs to isolate and resolve application issues, review error reports, and clear error backlogs.
 Submit and track tickets with Versaterm Support, and coordinate troubleshooting with Versaterm teams.
 Handle system problems and outage calls during on-duty hours. After-hours critical support is handled by Versaterm 24/7 technical support.
 Assist agency trainers with application-specific content and work with trainers and users to reduce repeat errors.
 Mentor and coach Customer and RPA staff on CAD/MDT administration, and establish best practices for configuration, change control, and documentation.
 Relationship Management and Reporting 
 Act as the resident expert on each agency's CAD configuration, and advise on new policies, processes, or technology implementations.
 Apply sound judgment to resolve complex or ambiguous issues independently, escalating to Versaterm teams when needed and keeping the Customer and RPAs informed.
 Help manage cross-department needs and dependencies within the applications.
 Represent the Managed Service Provider to the Business Relationship Manager (NB911) to coordinate changes, updates, and corrections.
 Participate in meetings and work sessions on CAD/MDT administration.
 Submit regular system status reports and a monthly report covering all incident activity and work performed.
 Coordinate PTO with the Customer and RPAs so coverage is planned in advance.
 Do not respond to requests for personally identifiable information (PII). The Customer and RPAs approve and handle those requests.
 What You Bring 
 A minimum of 5-7 years of experience in public safety CAD administration, dispatch systems support, or a comparable technical specialist role.
 In-depth understanding of CAD and MDT systems, ideally Versaterm vCAD or comparable public safety dispatch platforms.
 Hands-on experience configuring and administering CAD, including units, status codes, incident types, response plans, and user security.
 Working knowledge of GIS data and public safety mapping (centerlines, address points, response areas, AVL).
 Experience with test, training, and production environments, release promotion, and acceptance testing.
 Strong troubleshooting skills, including log and error report analysis.
 Demonstrated ability to deliver complex work autonomously, apply sound judgment, and navigate ambiguity in a customer-facing role.
 Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to dispatchers, supervisors, trainers, and IT staff.
 Experience mentoring or coaching others and implementing best practices in system administration.
 Self-directed and organized, with a record of working effectively in a remote setting.
 Models Versaterm's values and brings them into how they work with the Customer, RPAs, and Versaterm colleagues.
 Education, training, and experience sufficient to meet contract requirements, and the ability to obtain and maintain the required security clearance.
 Note: T his position requires a security clearance from the Government of Canada. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Canada and must successfully obtain and maintain a Reliability security clearance. Please note that specific customer contracts may impose additional security verification requirements. Obtaining and maintaining all required security clearances is a condition of employment. For more information on the Government of Canada's security screening process, please visit Public Services and Procurement Canada .

About Taiga   
 Taiga Motors is a rapidly scaling electric vehicle technology and manufacturing company leading the electrification of off-road powersports. Built on a clean-sheet platform, our vehicles deliver industry-leading power-to-weight performance and connected technology without sacrificing the environment. We work fast, dream big, and relentlessly chase perfection. 
 The Role  
 As the Vehicle Program Manager, you will serve as the operational nerve center for new vehicle development, steering products from initial concept through to a successful Start of Production (SOP). Reporting directly to the CEO, you will act as a trusted integrator across the organization, removing roadblocks and ensuring that cross-functional teams execute flawlessly. 
 You will be responsible for orchestrating the entire New Product Introduction (NPI) lifecycle. Your ultimate mandate is to introduce major coordinated changes and new vehicle platforms into the factory on time, on cost, and at the highest quality standards, adopting a "non-event launch" mentality. 
 Key Responsibilities  
 Program planning  
 Build and own the integrated master schedule for each program, linking engineering, tooling, supplier, certification, manufacturing and commercial milestones to product introduction gates.
 Work with department leads to confirm their gate deliverables, owners and due dates, and track the critical path.
 Manage scope and engineering changes through the existing change-control process, showing impact on cost, timing and quality. 
 Cross-functional execution  
 Run the weekly cross-functional program meeting; drive actions to closure.
 Check gate readiness: confirm each department's deliverables are complete before a gate review, and chase gaps early.
 Facilitate gate reviews and give the CEO a clear go/no-go recommendation backed by data. Record the decision, open risks and conditions to proceed.
 Resolve cross-department conflicts and dependencies; escalate to the CEO with options when trade-offs need a decision. 
 Cost, risk and quality  
 Track program cost against targets with Finance: BOM cost, tooling and capex, development budget, and launch volumes. Flag variances early.
 Maintain the program risk and issue register and drive mitigation plans with the owning departments.
 Follow quality readiness with Quality and Supply Chain: DFMEA/PFMEA actions, validation and certification status, supplier PPAP, and launch quality targets. 
 Launch readiness  
 Own the launch readiness plan: manufacturing ramp-up, supplier capacity, service readiness (parts, training, documentation), software release, and sales and marketing timing.
 Run launch readiness reviews and the SOP go/no-go checklist.
 Lead post-launch reviews to close open issues and capture lessons learned for the next program. 
 Qualifications & Requirements  
 Education: Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial, or related field).
 Experience : 5-10+ years of experience in complex manufacturing, automotive, or EV environments, with a minimum of 3 years directly managing NPI, Launch, or Vehicle Programs.
 Technical Acumen: Proven ability to read mechanical drawings and CAD models, coupled with a deep understanding of manufacturing equipment, automation, and tooling.
 Systems Knowledge: Previous experience successfully navigating and validating Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) and ERP systems.
 Problem Solving: Excellent problem-solving skills with hands-on experience utilizing statistical tools and Six Sigma principles (e.g., DOE, root cause analysis) to optimize scalable processes.
 Leadership Style: Resilient, flexible, and comfortable with ambiguity. A strong capacity to influence without direct authority and inspire teams in a fast-paced startup environment. 
 What We Offer  
 The opportunity to play a foundational role in shaping the future of outdoor exploration for a leading electric vehicle brand.
 Hands-on experience with Taiga vehicles—see the impact of your work out in the wild. 
 Benefits  
 Fast-paced environment within a growing manufacturing company
 Company events – barbecues, employee demo days, etc.
 Comprehensive health plan
 Group RRSP

Oracle Cloud Technical Architect
 Location: Canada – Remote 
 Department: Finance 
 Position: Oracle Cloud Technical Architect 
 The world of payment processing is rapidly evolving, and businesses are looking for loyal and strategic partners to help them grow.
 Meet Nuvei. Nuvei is the global fintech building the infrastructure for every payment, everywhere. Its modular, flexible, and scalable technology enables leading companies to accept next-generation payments, offer all payout options, and benefit from card issuing, banking, risk, and fraud management services. Connecting businesses to their customers in more than 200 markets, with local acquiring in 52 markets, 150 currencies, and over 720 alternative payment methods, Nuvei provides the technology and insights for customers and partners to succeed locally and globally through one integration.
 At Nuvei, we live our core values, and we thrive on solving complex problems. We are dedicated to continually improving our product and providing relentless customer service. We are always looking for exceptional talent to join us on the journey!
 Your Mission
 Nuvei is looking for an Oracle Cloud Technical Architect to lead the Oracle technical layer of the UFS Reimagined program within the Global Finance organization. The program is delivering Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP and EPM across the Nuvei finance landscape in two waves, alongside a systems integrator and a number of specialist partners for 3rd party solutions being implemented in parallel. This role sits on the Nuvei side of that program and holds the Oracle technical authority for Global Finance.
 The person in this role sets the standard and stands behind it. They will review and approve the integration architecture proposed by the systems integrator, define connectivity, identity, and environment requirements across the Oracle ecosystem, lead the architecture and security clearance work for the Oracle connections to Kyriba and Sovos, and cover the Oracle Integration Cloud posting path from the business rules platform into the general ledger. Where a design decision has to be made, defended, or refused, this person makes it.
 The role reports to the Director, Oracle Solutions and works in close collaboration with functional business process leads, the systems integrator's technical team, Nuvei's enterprise architecture and information security teams, the incoming application managed support partner, and the owners of the upstream and downstream systems that Oracle Fusion Cloud connects to. It is a hands-on architecture role, not a coordination role, and it continues beyond go-live as the permanent Oracle technical owner within Nuvei.
 This role will suit someone with ten or more years of Oracle technical experience, including several full Fusion Cloud implementation lifecycles from requirements through cutover and hypercare, who has carried architecture accountability through a security and compliance approval process and has taken a newly implemented ecosystem into a sustained support model.
 Responsibilities
 The role covers four areas. The balance of work shifts across the program, moving from integration architecture and clearance work during the build, through cutover and hypercare at each wave, into sustained ownership of the Oracle ecosystem once the application managed support model is running.
 Integration Architecture and Oracle Integration Cloud
 • Review the systems integrator's solution design for every in-scope interface and confirm the appropriate Oracle Integration Cloud or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure integration pattern, including orchestration, scheduling, retries, idempotency, and recovery behaviour.
 • Define endpoints, authentication, service accounts, certificates, encryption, privileged access, network routes, and environment-specific configuration for each connection between Oracle Fusion Cloud and the surrounding application ecosystem.
 • Facilitate the technical discussions between the systems integrator and the peripheral system teams, covering systems governed by Finance, Corporate-IT, systems outside its current footprint, and third-party managed platforms, and hold the functional and technical flow of each interface.
 • Document the standards the build is held to for orchestration, scheduling, retries, error handling, logging, monitoring, and alerting, and review partner-produced designs against them.
 • Own the Oracle Integration Cloud posting path from the business rules platform on Azure and Snowflake into the Oracle general ledger, including file-based data import, aggregated journal delivery, drill-back lineage, and reconciliation points.
 • Lead architecture checkpoints during build and testing, approve deviations from the agreed standards, and authorize the technical transition of each interface into production.
 Architecture, Security, and Cloud Clearances
 • Lead the Oracle side of the architecture and security clearances required for Oracle Fusion Cloud to connect to the Kyriba and Sovos cloud platforms, both of which hold Nuvei data on third-party infrastructure and clear on their own merits.
 • Produce the evidence the enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, and third-party risk forums require, including context and data-flow diagrams, control assessments, test results, and remediation status.
 • Translate approval conditions into actionable design, configuration, testing, and evidence requirements, and drive them to closure with the partner, vendor, security, and infrastructure teams before production deployment.
 • Contribute the Oracle integration and technical assurance view to the business rules management platform being built on Nuvei's own Azure tenant, including its architecture and security clearance packs.
 • Confirm environment topology, segregation, capacity, availability, performance, scalability, configuration management, deployment paths, and separation of duties across the Oracle landscape.
 • Accept the formal handover from the enterprise and infrastructure architects, validating decisions, conditions, accepted exceptions, dependencies, risks, and open actions, and carry them forward as the standing Oracle technical authority.
 Post Go-Live Sustainment and the Hybrid Support Model
 • Represent Nuvei in the selection and onboarding of the application managed support partner, including responses to vendor clarifications, evaluation of proposed support models, and technical assessment of the bids.
 • Own the in-house share of the hybrid support model, covering infrastructure, IT service management, and the portion of the integration ecosystem that is retained rather than outsourced.
 • Lead the knowledge transition from the systems integrator into Global Finance and the support partner, and confirm that support ownership, service expectations, incident routing, and escalation paths are agreed for every production interface.
 • Govern the hypercare period at each wave, then the steady-state support model, ensuring month-end close and year-end are treated as the critical windows they are.
 • Define the technical side of the proactive operations monitoring model, including thresholds, observability, alert routing, dashboards, and the runbooks each participating team operates from.
 • Carry wave-one lessons into wave-two readiness for the larger and more complex regional scope and maintain technical authority for clearance-related changes and exceptions through the sustainment period.
 Environment, Ecosystem, and Technical Governance
 • Own the Oracle Fusion Cloud environment landscape, including refresh planning, environment scheduling across workstreams, quarterly update readiness, and regression coverage.
 • Govern the Oracle Cloud Infrastructure tenancy supporting the ecosystem, including compartments, identity domains, policies, network topology, service limits, cost, and service health.
 • Set the technical standards for Fusion security, including role design support, data access sets, and segregation of duties, and review changes against them.
 • Assess non-functional requirements for availability, performance, scalability, resilience, disaster recovery, auditability, and supportability before any build is approved.
 • Review deployment and support artefacts, approve the final technical evidence and handover, and ensure the ecosystem remains compliant and supportable after implementation.
 Requirements
 • Ten or more years of hands-on Oracle technical experience, including multiple full Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation lifecycles from requirements through cutover and hypercare.
 • Demonstrated architecture accountability on an Oracle Fusion Cloud program, including ownership of integration architecture, technical standards, and design approval across a partner-delivered build.
 • Deep, current Oracle Integration Cloud experience covering orchestrations, adapters, mappings, fault handling, scheduling, and the review of designs produced by others.
 • Strong command of Oracle Fusion Cloud integration surfaces, including REST and SOAP web services, the ERP Integration Service, file-based data import, and business events.
 • Practical Oracle Cloud Infrastructure experience across identity and access management, compartments, policies, networking, and service limits, sufficient to govern a tenancy rather than only operate in one.
 • Experience taking an Oracle ecosystem through enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, and third-party risk clearance, including evidence packs, conditions, compensating controls, and formal approval.
 • Experience integrating Oracle Fusion Cloud with third-party software-as-a-service platforms hosted outside the corporate network, including connectivity, certificate, and identity design.
 • Working knowledge of cloud data platforms such as Azure and Snowflake, sufficient to design and assure the interface between a rules-based subledger and the Oracle general ledger.
 • Strong SQL and PL/SQL, together with reporting knowledge across BI Publisher and OTBI, sufficient to review, challenge, and troubleshoot technical objects built by others.
 • Experience transitioning a newly implemented Oracle ecosystem into a managed support model, including hybrid arrangements shared between an internal team and a support partner.
 • Clear and direct communicator, able to hold a position in an architecture or security review and to work effectively with finance leadership, partner technical teams, and system owners.
 • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
 Assets
 • Experience across the Oracle Fusion Cloud financials footprint, particularly General Ledger, Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets, Cash Management, and Projects.
 • Exposure to Oracle EPM Cloud and its integration with Fusion ERP through Data Management or Data Integration.
 • Experience with high-volume transactional integration in a payments, fintech, or financial services environment, including daily settlement and reconciliation cycles.
 • Familiarity with treasury and indirect tax cloud platforms such as Kyriba and Sovos, and with the integration patterns they require.
 • Oracle certification in Integration Cloud, Cloud Infrastructure architecture, or Fusion Financials.
 • Experience of a business rules engine, decision-table, or rules-driven subledger platform, and of the controls that make one auditable.
 • Working knowledge of DevOps practice for cloud integration, including source control, automated deployment, and release governance.
 Benefits
 Nuvei is an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates collaboration and innovation and is committed to developing a diverse and inclusive workplace. The team at Nuvei is comprised of a wealth of talent, skill, and ambition. We believe that employees are happiest when they are empowered to be their true, authentic selves. So, please come as you are. We can't wait to meet you.
 • Competitive holiday allowance
 • Group Insurance Benefits
 • Flexible working model
 • Employee Assistance Program
 Working Language
 English (written and spoken) is the language used most of the time, as work colleagues, clients, and strategic suppliers are geographically dispersed.
 This position offers an expected compensation range of [$130,000-$150,000] per year, in accordance with Ontario’s pay transparency requirements.”

Marriage Reset is on a mission to save one million marriages. Our coaching programs help men rebuild their relationships and become better husbands. More than 7500 clients have enrolled, and our content has generated millions of views across social platforms.
 We are hiring a Creative Director to take full ownership of our organic social department. Paid media currently drives most of our client acquisition. We want to build a stronger organic presence that earns trust in the brand and consistently generates qualified inbound calls.
 Instagram is our main growth priority. You will be responsible for the content strategy and creative standards across all our organic channels, with the autonomy to lead the department and accountability for its performance.
 The role 
 You will work directly with Josh Hudson, our co-founder and main spokesperson, to develop the brand’s organic content strategy. You will plan several months ahead, establish the monthly content agenda, and direct the work from initial concept to final approval.
 Your responsibilities include developing content angles, writing scripts in Josh’s voice, and preparing recording briefs. You will run a content waterfall that turns long-form recordings into content tailored to each platform, with a consistent production and publishing schedule.
 You will manage and develop the editors and copywriters, review their work, and take responsibility for the quality of everything we publish. You will also work with the wider marketing team to maintain a consistent brand across our digital presence.
 Performance analysis will guide the strategy. Across all organic channels, you will assess audience growth and content performance, then work with sales to understand the contribution to qualified enquiries and booked calls. You will use that evidence to set priorities and improve results.
 We expect you to take initiative, make informed creative decisions and lead the department without close supervision.
 Requirements 
 • Proven organic social growth | A track record of growing an account for a founder, brand or yourself, supported by starting and ending audience figures, a clear timeframe and evidence of your personal contribution.
 • Strategic content leadership | Experience developing content strategies over several months, directing production and adapting the plan based on performance. You must be able to connect day-to-day creative decisions to the wider business objectives.
 • Advanced copywriting and scriptwriting | Strong command of hooks, storytelling and copywriting frameworks, with the ability to translate a founder’s expertise into compelling content that retains their voice.
 • Content waterfall implementation | Experience building and managing a repeatable system for turning long-form recordings into short-form video and other content adapted to different platforms.
 • Management of both video editors and copywriters | Direct experience setting briefs, reviewing scripts and edits, coaching team members, and holding them accountable for quality and deadlines.
 • Practical AI experience | Experience integrating AI into content production or editing workflows, with editorial oversight to protect accuracy, quality, and brand voice.
 • Excellent written and spoken English | The ability to write persuasive, natural copy for an English-speaking audience and communicate precise creative direction.
 Preferred experience 
 We place particular weight on substantial growth achieved for a founder’s account, especially on Instagram. Candidates with strong results from their own accounts or other brands will also be considered.
 • Significant audience growth | Adding around 100,000 followers to another person’s account, or growing your own account to that size, is highly valued. This is a preference, not a minimum eligibility requirement.
 • Coaching industry experience | Experience in any coaching specialty is an advantage. We also consider candidates from other industries who meet the core requirements.
 • YouTube or other long-form audience growth | A record of building an audience through long-form content.
 • Commercial results | A demonstrable contribution to multimillion-dollar sales, with a clear understanding of how that contribution was measured.
 Working arrangement 
 -This is a fully remote engagement under an independent contractor agreement, requiring a full-time commitment. The compensation package includes a base salary plus performance incentives linked to sales.
 -Time zone and core working hours: EST/PST
 Applications 
 -Please apply only if you meet the required criteria and can provide evidence of your experience. Applications that do not meet these requirements will not be progressed. 
 -Applications must be submitted through this job posting or our website. Please do not send applications or follow-up enquiries by direct message.
 -Shortlisted candidates will be contacted within one to two weeks of applying. If you have not heard from us within two weeks, your application has not been shortlisted.
 Thank you for your interest in Marriage Reset!

Can You Spot An Influencer Who’ll Actually Sell? You know that good partnerships don’t just “create buzz.” They drive revenue, build authority, and make competitors wonder how the heck you’re everywhere at once. You know how to build a scalable affiliate program where the right partners drive sales, the right experts build trust, and every campaign has the tracking and reporting to prove it.
If that sounds like you, you might have what it takes to be the Senior Influencer and Partnerships Specialist at AlgaeCal.
 Small Print ⇒ If you think influencer marketing is about collecting “likes” this role isn’t for you. We’re looking for someone who can build a performance-driven partnership ecosystem, manage creators and affiliates, negotiate smart deals, and sniff out wasted spend faster than a bloodhound chasing a runaway sausage cart.
 This job will give you ALL the feels: 
 We create clinically supported, natural solutions for some of the biggest health challenges women over 40 face today. And your work will help more women discover those solutions. The creators, affiliates, and experts you bring into our world will help women find information they can trust, feel more confident in their choices, and take action on their health.
 If that excites you, you’ll find no better place to continue your career than here.
 This job might be for you if… 
 You know how to find the right partners. A creator with 500,000 followers doesn’t automatically make your pulse race. You look at audience fit, engagement, credibility, brand alignment, and whether there’s a realistic path to revenue. You’re not here to collect vanity metrics. You’re here to build a pipeline of influencers, creators, affiliates, and healthcare experts who can actually perform.
 You’re comfortable working with performance data. ROAS, CAC, conversion rate, attributed revenue, and performance by partner aren’t things you leave for someone else to figure out. You know how to read the data, spot what’s working, kill what isn’t, and put more money behind the partnerships that deserve it.
 You know how to build strong relationships. Great partnerships aren’t built by firing over a contract and resurfacing three months later asking for a report. You know how to build trust, communicate clearly, create offers people actually want to say yes to, and keep good partners wanting to work with us again. From first conversation to signed agreement to live campaign to reporting, you know how to keep the whole thing moving.
 You understand how affiliate programs work. You’re not the kind of person who opens Impact and stares hopefully at the dashboard. You understand recruitment, activation, commission structures, incentives, optimization, and what it takes to turn a handful of affiliates into a real growth channel. Experience with Impact, Klear, GRIN, Shopify Affiliates, or similar platforms will definitely come in handy.
 You know how valuable the right expert can be. Healthcare professionals and science experts aren’t there to make the About Us page look impressive. The right expert can build trust, strengthen credibility, and make people pay attention. You know how to help find, nurture, and manage those relationships while keeping advisory agreements, expert content, and ongoing initiatives moving forward.
 You know how to make campaigns measurable. UTMs, GA4, attribution, affiliate links, conversion paths, dashboards—you want the plumbing in place before anyone hits publish. If a campaign launches and nobody can tell where the sales came from, you start developing an eye twitch. You can build clean tracking systems, spot reporting holes, and make sure every partnership has a clear line of sight to performance.
 You know how to manage a budget.  You know when a creator is worth the fee, when the numbers don’t stack up, and when it’s time to negotiate harder, change the deal, or walk away. You pity the fools who throw five figures at an influencer because “their engagement looks really strong.”
 You know how to get campaigns over the finish line. Brief → negotiation → content → compliance → approvals → launch → tracking → reporting → optimization. You’ve managed the whole thing before. You can keep multiple campaigns moving at once, chase down loose ends without becoming everyone’s least favourite Slack notification, and make sure things actually launch on time.
 You keep an eye on the competition. Which creators are competitors using? What offers are they testing? What messages keep showing up? Who seems to be everywhere all of a sudden? You notice the patterns, find the gaps, and turn what you learn into better ideas for us. Not a 53-slide competitor deck that gets presented once and then quietly dies in Google Drive.
 You’re good at getting different people to work together. Creative, paid media, compliance, analytics, external partners—you can keep everyone aligned without turning every decision into a meeting about whether we need another meeting. You communicate clearly, keep momentum high, and generally make complicated things feel less complicated.
 You’ve got the experience to prove you can do all of the above. We’re looking for 3+ years in influencer marketing, affiliate management, partnerships, creator growth, or a similar role. Bonus points if you’ve worked in health, wellness, supplements, D2C, eCommerce, women’s health, or another category where credibility matters just as much as conversion.
 Now, time to be honest… is this really you? 
If you’re nodding your head and already thinking about which partners, systems, and campaign levers you’d tackle first, then we can’t wait to meet you.
 Other Qualities You’ll Need
 At AlgaeCal, we’re going to insist that you have these 3 qualities:
 You’re humble –you put the team and others’ needs ahead of your own
 You’re hungry to learn more
 You’re people-smart –in the sense that you’re a great teammate
 The truth is, if you don’t have these qualities, you won’t last long at AlgaeCal. So if you’re missing one of them, be honest. Save yourself a lot of headaches and skip to a job posting that is a better fit for you.
 What Will You Earn?
 We believe in rewarding top talent. So let’s talk about salary once we’ve had the chance to get to know you better. Rest assured, we’re generous and offer above-market pay for the right person. If you bring the skills and experience, we’ll make sure the compensation reflects that.
 You’ll also enjoy the following benefits:
 A generous healthcare package
 Monthly team events and activities
 Flexible Stat Holidays with the option to bank days for later use
 Weekly team lunches
 Casual dress code
 Incredible dog-friendly, Yaletown office one block from SkyTrain
 And above all, you’ll join a team that you’ll never want to leave. Culture is everything to us. Yes, we work extremely hard to change as many people’s lives as possible. But we know how to have fun and reward ourselves too.
 How To Apply
 So, do you have what it takes to become the next member of team AlgaeCal?
 Job opportunities like this don’t come along often, and we’ve got a lot to offer our successful applicant. So, to make sure our future Senior Influencer and Partnerships Specialist is the real deal, will be a great fit, and will thrive at AlgaeCal, we ask a little more than your run-of-the-mill job application:

 1. Write a cover letter addressing: 
 Why are you the best Senior Influencer and Partnerships Specialist for this role? Give quantifiable examples of related achievements like campaign ROI, ROAS, CAC, incremental sales lift, volume of creators managed, or others that show the impact of your work.
 Describe why you fit perfectly with our values. Read them here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1deCCJZ6tiDiOSlr_W0UdCuM_V_ahzPBs/view

ABOUT THE CAPITAL MARKETS TEAM

Capital Markets is responsible for the company’s financial markets facing businesses including daily trading operations, opportunity identification and growing those business lines. As Wealthsimple’s interface to the markets we are ultimately responsible for the execution of all the firm’s orders both on behalf of our clients and the company’s own trading activities. In order to accomplish this we work closely with and partner with functions across the company.





ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Quantitative Trader at Wealthsimple, you’ll be conducting research and building models that describe how the markets behave, turn that research into algorithms and business insights to produce an edge for our clients and the company. You will also manage the daily trading operations of those systems. In this role you will have the opportunity to apply the theoretical, coming up with ideas, simulating to prove a thesis, validating with real world results and dynamically responding to changing conditions.  - Develop trading algorithms to programmatically decide how orders are generated and routed, and work alongside engineers to deploy those systems into production.

 - Manage the daily trading operations of our algorithmic trading systems.

 - Respond to changing market conditions to ensure algorithms are placing orders optimally.

 - Partner cross-functionally with engineering, data science, operations and product teams.

 - STEM degree from a leading institution

 - Excellent Python scripting

 - Solid foundation in statistics, probability, stochastic processes, and quantitative methods

 - Understanding of Canadian equity market structure

 - Familiarity with low-latency trading technologies and methodologies

 - CIRO-registered as a trader is an asset



WHO YOU ARE

 - You take ownership, and want to directly drive outcomes. You will come up with the ideas, prove those ideas out, get them implemented and be responsible for how they run day in and day out. Holding yourself accountable for the results.

 What is The Role 
 The Elastic Security Endpoint Protections team researches, designs, and builds the visibility and prevention capabilities at the core of Elastic Defend, our endpoint and SIEM security solution. We are looking for a Senior Security Research Engineer to help lead our efforts to build innovative features that secure our users against the latest emerging threats. You will collaborate with the broader Elastic Security team, a diverse group of skilled researchers, data scientists, and engineers who bring deep domain knowledge in their respective areas. Our geographically dispersed team values positivity and inclusivity in the workplace, clear communication, collaborative learning, and guided mentorship.
 We don't just claim our protections work. In recent third-party enterprise protection testing, Elastic Security earned a perfect malware protection score with zero false alarms, the top result in the field. If you have a passion for security research and would enjoy the challenge of devising novel methods for thwarting malicious actors in an ever-evolving threat landscape, join our growing team!
 What You Will Be Doing
 Research emerging attacker techniques and turn them into shipped protections. Study real-world tradecraft across in-memory threats, injection, credential theft, ransomware, and kernel tampering, then design protections that hold up against an adversary actively trying to defeat them.
 Build and extend endpoint visibility. Instrument new event sources across Windows, macOS, and Linux, deepen the telemetry we already collect, and close the gaps attackers rely on. Every source you add becomes a foundation for other teams.
 Develop production code that runs everywhere. Write performant, stable C/C++ that executes on millions of endpoints, where a memory leak or a few milliseconds of overhead is a customer-visible problem.
 Reverse engineer malware and study evasion. Learn how attackers bypass endpoint security controls in the wild, and feed that understanding directly into the protections you design and harden.
 Own efficacy end to end. Review customer telemetry at fleet scale, investigate false positives and performance regressions, and establish mitigation strategies. Shipping the feature is the beginning of the job, not the end.
 Extend protection parity across platforms. Bring the depth we have on Windows to macOS and Linux, and support new hardware architectures as they reach the enterprise.
 Collaborate across Elastic Security. Implement endpoint code alongside peers in multiple countries and time zones, and work with the detection engineers, malware researchers, and data scientists who rely on your telemetry.
 Help lead the team's technical direction. Take point on initiatives that span multiple releases, raise the bar in design and code reviews, and mentor engineers earlier in their careers.
 Publish and present. Share your research on Elastic Security Labs, present at conferences, and contribute to the open source projects that organizations around the world rely on.
 What You Bring
 6+ years of professional experience analyzing attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) and building detection methods for real security threats.
 6+ years of development experience in C, C++, and Python , with the judgment to write code that is safe, fast, and maintainable in a security-critical codebase.
 Deep operating system internals knowledge , in both kernel and user mode, deep enough to reason about undocumented behavior and find security-relevant structures nobody has written about yet. Windows depth is what we need most, with macOS or Linux depth close behind.
 In-depth reverse engineering and malware analysis experience , and comfort with the tooling that makes hard binaries readable.
 An adversarial instinct. You anticipate how a protection will be evaded before it ships, and design for resilience rather than for the proof of concept in front of you.
 A collaborative mentality and an eagerness to learn new skills, new platforms, and emerging technologies.
 You have a proven track record of using AI to accelerate development, debug complex systems, and optimize code, while still owning the final outcomes.
 You work autonomously and can drive decisions and results in a distributed team by leveraging asynchronous, direct, and transparent communication.
 Passion for protecting the world's data from attack! 
 Bonus Points
 Vulnerability research and exploit development, particularly with a track record of responsible disclosure to platform vendors.
 Red teaming experience, or a background in building offensive tooling and defeating endpoint security products.
 Kernel-mode development, including driver development and debugging.
 Ownership or long-term maintenance of an open-source security tool with a real user base.
 Conference speaking experience (e.g., Black Hat, DEF CON, CODE BLUE, Virus Bulletin) or an established publication record.
 Experience applying machine learning to endpoint security problems.
 Familiarity with the Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) and Elastic Security.

About Clutch
 Clutch is Canada’s largest online used car retailer, delivering a seamless, hassle-free car buying and selling experience. Customers can sell their car instantly online using our ML-driven pricing model, or browse thousands of cars to buy, all from the comfort of their home.
 Named three years in a row to the Globe & Mail’s list of the Top Growing Companies in Canada and awarded spots on Deloitte’s Technology Fast 50™ and Fast 500™ lists, we’re looking to add curious, hard-working, and driven individuals to our growing team.
 Headquartered in Toronto, Clutch was founded in 2017 and is backed by world-class investors including Canaan, BrandProject, Real Ventures, D1 Capital, and Upper90.
 About the team 
 Product & Design is Clutch’s creative engine.
 We solve some of the hardest problems in the business: improving the customer experience, building internal tools that power our operations, running growth experiments, connecting systems and data, and finding better ways to buy, sell, and move cars.
 The way we build products has changed significantly.
 Using Ignition, our platform for agentic engineering, individuals can now work across parts of the product-development process that traditionally required several specialized roles. A project that once involved a large team for months can increasingly be owned by one or two people and shipped in days.
 We call those people builders .
 A builder can move from understanding a business problem to shaping a solution, designing the experience, building it, testing it against realistic data, putting it in front of users, and iterating based on what they learn.
 This role is for someone excited by the fact that the boundaries between product, design, and engineering are becoming increasingly blurry.
 What you’ll do
 Own important product problems end-to-end, from understanding the business and user problem through building and shipping the solution
 Immerse yourself in Clutch’s operations, customers, systems, processes, and data to understand how things actually work
 Challenge requests and assumptions to make sure we’re solving the right problem rather than simply building what was asked for
 Shape product solutions and design elegant, intuitive experiences users enjoy using
 Use AI and agentic development tools to build working products across the front end and back end
 Work with APIs, business logic, data, and existing Clutch systems to turn ideas into functioning software
 Put working products in front of stakeholders and users early rather than relying solely on specs, mockups, or prototypes
 Test against realistic scenarios and data to uncover edge cases before launch
 Ship quickly, learn from real usage, and continuously improve what you’ve built
 Run experiments and measure whether your work is actually solving the problem
 Work directly with operators, designers, engineers, marketers, and other specialists when their expertise improves the outcome
 Improve our product-development practices as the tools and capabilities available to builders continue to evolve
 Minimum requirements
 4+ years of experience building digital products in product design, product management, software engineering, or a similarly hands-on product role
 Strong product sense — you think about the product and business as a whole rather than as a collection of features or screens
 Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous problems and turn them into thoughtful, practical solutions
 Strong UX instincts and a high bar for making products intuitive and enjoyable to use
 Curiosity about users and a willingness to spend time understanding how they actually work
 Comfort using AI-assisted or agentic tools to build software, or a strong desire to become highly proficient with them
 Willingness to work outside the traditional boundaries of your discipline
 Ability to learn unfamiliar technical or business domains quickly
 Bias toward shipping, testing, learning, and iterating
 You do not need to be an expert designer, product manager, and software engineer at the same time. You do need to be willing and able to move beyond your existing specialty when the problem requires it.
 Preferred qualifications
 Experience at a startup, either as an early employee or founder
 Experience owning products from problem discovery through launch and iteration
 Experience working directly with engineers or contributing to production code
 Experience building with modern AI coding or agentic development tools
 Experience with experimentation, A/B testing, analytics, or product-led growth
 Experience building internal tools or software for operationally complex businesses
 Comfort working with APIs, data, and unfamiliar systems
 Ability to work on multiple projects in parallel and prioritize based on business impact
 Evidence of having taught yourself skills outside your formal discipline
 You WILL NOT enjoy this role if
 You want your responsibilities to stay strictly within the boundaries of design, product management, or engineering
 You prefer handing work off to another function once your part is complete
 You want to spend most of your time producing specifications, presentations, or Figma files rather than working software
 You are uncomfortable touching code because you don’t consider yourself a developer
 You prefer firm processes over adaptive ones
 You need every problem to be clearly defined before you begin
 You don’t like being scrappy
 You don’t like small, agile teams
 You optimize primarily for how much you can build rather than whether something should be built
 What makes a great builder at Clutch
 Great builders are curious.
 They want to understand the business logic underneath the thing they’re working on. They talk to users. They inspect the data. They challenge assumptions. They ask why a problem exists before deciding how to solve it.
 They have judgment.
 When building becomes dramatically easier, choosing what to build — and what not to build — becomes even more important. Great builders care about solving meaningful problems and measuring whether their solution actually worked.
 They have taste.
 They care whether a product feels elegant, intuitive, and complete. They sweat the details and cover the edge cases rather than treating quality as something to address later.
 And they build.
 They are excited to use new tools, learn unfamiliar skills, move quickly from an idea to working software, sit beside the people using it, and change it again.
 Why you’ll love it at Clutch
 Autonomy & ownership — own meaningful problems from beginning to end
 Real-world impact — improve how hundreds of frontline employees learn and work
 A unique design space — combine product, learning, gamification, AI, and operations
 Fast feedback loops — put working software in front of users and improve it quickly
 Compensation & Benefits 
 Salary: $150,000 - $200,000 annually 
 Equity incentives
 Comprehensive healthcare, dental, vision, prescriptions, life insurance, and dependent coverage
 Pay reflects skills, performance, market benchmarking, responsibilities, and working conditions
 Clutch is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all individuals have an opportunity to succeed. If you require accommodation at any stage of the interview process, please email talent@clutch.ca .

 About the job 
 As a Senior Internal Auditor, you will play a pivotal role in maintaining and elevating our internal control environment. You’ll step beyond traditional compliance to drive strategic impact, business resilience, and operational excellence across a fast-paced tech ecosystem. We are looking for a collaborative, forward-thinking auditor who thrives in a fast-growing environment to help elevate our global internal controls. Reporting directly to the Senior Manager of Internal Audit, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan, execute, and deliver high-impact, risk-based operational audits.  End-to-End Operational Audits: Plan, execute, and deliver risk-based operational and compliance reviews across global functions. Document process flows and testing workpapers with limited supervision.
 Audit Reporting: Draft high-impact audit reports for stakeholders that go beyond “finding errors” to provide strategic insights and root-cause analysis. 
 Remediation & Action: Track management action plans to ensure sustainable risk mitigation. 
 Audit Innovation: Drive the adoption of AI and automation tools to streamline audit workflows, boost efficiency, and deliver actionable business insights. 
 SOX & Financial Controls: Support the SOX program by testing the design and operating effectiveness of business process controls, assessing control deficiencies and monitoring remediation plans.
 Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with business teams to identify control gaps, optimize workflows, and build scalable processes aligned with industry best practices.
 Qualifications

If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Who we are
 About Stripe
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
 About the team
 The Data Foundations team drives Data Engineering and Data Apps and Tooling work across Stripe, enabling Stripes to leverage data to make informed decisions and build user-centric products. We provide tools and infrastructure to move, store, process, and analyze data, both at rest and in motion. We are looking for talented data-minded software engineers to help us manage business-critical data leveraged across the entire organization. If you are passionate about data, excited about designing data pipelines and data-driven user experiences, and motivated by having an outsized impact on the business, we want to hear from you.
 Team Matching: exact team matching for one of the subteams will begin during final stages. Please note we may also consider you for different orgs based on your experience, location, etc. More information on our team matching process can be found here .
 What you'll do
 Every record in our data warehouse is vitally important for the businesses that use Stripe, so we're looking for people with a strong background in software engineering and data to help us scale while maintaining correct and complete data. You'll work with a variety of internal teams across Product, Data Science, and GTM to help them solve their data needs. Your work will provide visibility into how these stakeholders and the Data Foundations organization are performing and how we can deliver a better experience to Stripe's customers.
 Responsibilities
 Design, develop, and own data pipelines, models, and products that power the Product, Data Science, and GTM functions
 Develop strong subject matter expertise and manage the service level agreements for both data pipelines and full stack web applications that support these critical stakeholders
 Build and refine Stripe's data foundations - infrastructure, pipelines, and tools to enable various teams at Stripe - working with Scala, Spark, and Airflow
 Leverage LLMs and Agents at scale to produce high-quality data on ambiguous problems
 Refine our existing data marts that help the GTM organization forecast the future potential performance of the business and reliably measure ongoing attainment toward targets
 Build data services that track key product metrics and measure the impact of different strategies employed by teams in the field
 Our tech stack is Spark, Scala, Java, SQL, and Python - and while we don't expect everyone on the team to be an expert in all of these, you will work across all of these technologies throughout your tenure on the team.
 Who you are
 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
 Minimum requirements
 Must have 6+ years of experience in a Software Engineering role, with a focus on building and maintaining data services or data-intensive applications
 A strong engineering background and an interest in data
 Prior experience with writing and debugging data pipelines using a distributed data framework (Spark, Hadoop, Pig, etc.)
 An inquisitive nature in diving into data inconsistencies to pinpoint issues and resolve deep-rooted data quality issues
 Knowledge of a backend development language (such as Scala, Java, or Go) and strong SQL experience
 The ability to communicate cross-functionally, derive requirements, and architect shared datasets
 Preferred qualifications
 Experience creating and maintaining data marts to power business reporting needs • Experience working with Product or GTM (Sales and Marketing) teams

Position Summary 
 The Rail Team Lead is responsible for overseeing and coordinating the activities of the Rail Team, including the Torch Operator and AZ Operator, while working on or alongside active rail lines and at designated rail sites.
 The Rail Team Lead is also responsible for maintaining a strong focus on team safety, monitoring rail traffic, communicating train movements to the team, and ensuring the team is able to safely clear the rail line within the required time and distance when a train is approaching.
 This position requires an individual who is highly detail-oriented, safety-focused, observant, and able to make sound decisions in a time-sensitive work environment. The Rail Team Lead will also support the team with documentation, field observations, minor repairs, and welding activities when the team is not actively working on the rail.
 What you’re responsible for: 
 Team Leadership & Coordination 
 Lead and coordinate the daily activities of the Rail Team, including the Torch Operator and AZ Operator.
 Provide direction to team members to ensure work is completed efficiently and according to job requirements.
 Maintain awareness of the team's location, activities, and progress throughout the workday.
 Ensure team members understand and follow established rail-site procedures.
 Maintain a strong focus on the safety and well-being of all team members.
 Communicate effectively with team members and other personnel working in the area.
 Rail Traffic Monitoring & Team Safety 
 Continuously monitor the radio for information regarding approaching trains and rail traffic.
 Listen for and communicate train movements and other relevant rail information to the team.
 Ensure the team is aware of approaching trains and has sufficient time to safely clear the rail.
 Direct the team to move off the rail and to a designated safe distance when required.

Shorten the inner loop. Time to first training run, edit-to-signal latency, local iteration before a job hits the cluster, fast failure over slow mystery. Measure it, publish it, drive it down.
Evangelize best-in-class tooling and frameworks. Track what the ecosystem is shipping, evaluate honestly, and make the case with working prototypes and migration paths — or say plainly when a shiny thing isn't worth the switching cost.

Turn one-off Python into durable tooling — tested, documented, observable libraries, CLIs, and services with sane defaults, and deletions where they're overdue.
Make experiments legible, with the teams who live in them: experiment hygiene, dashboards researchers trust, a real model registry, and lineage from dataset to checkpoint to simulation result.
Ship CI/CD for models alongside autonomy and simulation, so a model change is validated the same way a code change is.
Build observability across the ML stack — utilization, throughput, failure modes, queue times, cost per experiment. When a job fails at 3am on node 47, the researcher should find out why without you.
Treat docs, onboarding, and support as product surface — golden-path guides, a new researcher productive on day two, office hours that turn repeat questions into shipped fixes.
Drive adoption, not just availability. Prototype with real users, watch them work, iterate. A tool nobody adopts didn't ship.
Make the platform boringly reliable — fewer failures, faster recovery, and none of the manual steps that quietly cost a team days.

Fluency with containers, CI/CD, and modern build systems, including large monorepos.

Open-source contributions to ML infrastructure or developer tools.

Why join us 
 Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.
 Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.
 Operations at Brex 
 Operations is the backbone of Brex’s mission to power businesses through our Intelligent Finance Platform. We own credit, fraud, money movement, and payments, protecting our customers and our company. From product operations that ensure flawless launches to scalable systems that drive innovation and precision, we operate at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and customer success. If you want to work at the heart of the business, Operations is where you belong.
 What you'll do 
 You'll lead the Product Operations team and own the operational readiness for Brex's product launches: the enablement that must be in place before a customer ever touches a new feature. You'll also own Brex's product knowledge, the Help Center, and our internal knowledge base, plus the measurement that tells us whether it lands.
 This is a role for someone who combines product manager, data, and operations skills and behaviors. You'll inherit a team that has already automated a large share of its own workflow, with a suite of production agents running much of the recurring work. Your job is not only to keep that running, but to push it further: expand what AI carries and reinvest the capacity it frees into the judgment work only people can do. We want to raise our evidence bar by using key metrics to hold ourselves accountable, focus on where the impact is greatest, and celebrate our wins. We treat AI as leverage, not as a deliverable, and we measure it by how it improves our efficiency and the quality of our deliverables.
 Where you'll work 
 This role will be based in our Vancouver office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!
 Responsibilities: 
 Launch readiness and enablement 
 Own launch readiness, ensuring documentation, release notes, training, and tooling are ready for each release. Adapt processes and team capacity as EPD’s release cadence evolves.
 Lead and improve OLAB, the weekly cross-functional board that assesses launch impact and aligns teams on readiness.
 Engage early in launches, using customer and product insights to shape the product experience.
 Lead customer-facing escalations and crisis response, establishing a single source of truth, coordinating communications, and running retrospectives.
 Documentation and product knowledge 
 Own the lifecycle and quality of product documentation, keeping Help Center articles, internal knowledge, service descriptions, and implementation guides accurate, current, and clear.
 Partner with leadership and Engineering to structure and maintain product knowledge for people and AI systems.
 Turn AI support agent failure patterns into documentation improvements, with human validation of every AI-suggested change.
 Data and automation 
 Define actionable metrics for self-service, chatbot containment, knowledge adoption, and queue health, with clear thresholds, owners, and responses.
 Expand team automation and set standards for effective AI use, including where human judgment remains essential.
 Team and cross-functional leadership 
 Lead and develop a team of four product-domain owners, setting clear expectations and managing performance and career growth.
 Partner across product and customer-facing teams to deliver accurate, timely enablement, balancing readiness with delivery speed and making practical trade-offs.
 Communicate performance and strategy to CX leadership and executives, translating data into clear insights that drive decisions.
 Requirements 
 4+ years in Product Operations, Product Management, Program Management, or a related function, ideally in fast-paced tech or fintech.
 Experience partnering with Product and Engineering through full launch cycles, with confidence navigating scope, sequencing, and trade-offs.
 Experience leading projects, mentoring teammates, or developing others. First-time managers are welcome.
 Proven ability to scale cross-functional processes and influence partner teams without formal authority.
 Experience owning documentation or knowledge at scale, maintaining quality as products evolve.
 Strong analytical skills, including defining metrics, building useful dashboards, and using data to prioritize.
 Hands-on experience integrating AI agents and automation into workflows, with measurable improvements in efficiency or outcomes.
 Clear, precise communication across technical and non-technical audiences, including presenting data to leadership.
 Sound prioritization under competing demands and adaptability as processes and business needs change.
 Bonus points 
 Background in fintech, financial services, or enterprise SaaS.
 Experience as a Product Manager.
 1+ years managing or developing a team of 3+ individual contributors.
 Familiarity with structuring and maintaining product knowledge for AI systems at scale.
 Experience with self-service and containment metrics.
 Proficiency with tools such as Linear, Guru, Sanity, and Hex.
 Experience running cross-functional governance forums or advisory boards.
 A track record of turning operational insights into product roadmap changes.
 Compensation 
 The expected salary range for this role in Vancouver is $120,800 to $151,000 CAD. However, the starting base pay will depend on a number of factors including the candidate’s location, skills, experience, market demands, and internal pay parity. Depending on the position offered, equity and other forms of compensation may be provided as part of a total compensation package.
